snippet.title: KSP2 Redux Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
*KSP2 Redux* is a fan-driven revival of _Kerbal Space Program 2,_ going beyond just a typical mod in order to continue the game’s development where it was left off. The project's ultimate goal is to bring in the long-promised features and milestones that never came to be, and to make KSP2 into the game we all wanted it to become. That’s still a distant target, though; for now, the priority is nailing down a solid, reliable base for players and modders alike.

The initial release will focus on three main goals: major performance improvements, various bug fixes, and enhanced built-in modding support. There’s also a small surprise hidden in this first release—nothing major, just a little extra something that got added along the way. KSP2 Redux represents an exploration of everything this game has to offer us, and it's just the beginning of our mission to share what we've discovered.

Join us on the KSP2 Modding Society Discord to keep track of announcements and talk about all things Redux! https://discord.gg/8yq8d5VGQR

And we’re also on the KSP Forums! Keep up with the latest dev blogs and sneakpeak there as well! https://forum.kerbalspaceprogram.com/topic/226985-ksp2-redux/

*DISCLAIMER:*
This is a fan-made modification for Kerbal Space Program 2, created by the community and not affiliated with or endorsed by Private Division or its licensors. Kerbal Space Program and its logos are trademarks of Private Division LLC. All rights reserved. Any trademarks or copyrighted material used belong to their respective owners under fair use for informational purposes.

KSP2 Redux is free and intended for the enjoyment of the KSP community, with no commercial use implied.

*MUSIC:*
Intro by M83
